Female |location = |affiliation =[[Lee Moldaver|Miss Williams]] |TV actor =See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} The '''Hollywood Forever meeting attendees''' are characters {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Before the [[Great War]], these people attended [[Lee Moldaver|Miss Williams']] secret anti-[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] meetings at the [[Hollywood Forever]] funeral home. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Trap]]=== [[Sebastian Leslie]] would mention the group in his conversation with [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]] at his party. Sebastian would curse them and inform Cooper that his friend [[Charles Whiteknife]] was also radicalized by them. He went on to explain that the group has meetings, which he remarks as a "shitshow." Cooper later met with Charles at a bar and got into a debate with him over his [[Communism|communist]] ideology. Before leaving him, Charles suggested that he attend one of their meetings to see what [[Barb Howard]]'s work is truly all about. Eventually, Cooper would drive to [[Hollywood Forever]], where some attendees were seen walking into the building and later walking toward the main meeting room as Cooper followed them. He eventually ran into Charles and, after a brief chat with him, spoke to [[Lee Moldaver|Miss Williams]]. ===[[The Radio]]=== The meeting attendees attentively listened to Miss Williams' speech about the falsehoods of "the American Dream" that have been perpetually promoted throughout America's history. When Miss Williams starts talking about the soldiers who fought abroad, Cooper tries to leave, but is stopped by Miss Williams asking what he said under his breath while trying to leave. Cooper answers it, which leads to an impromptu debate about Cooper's principles and his supposed connection with [[Vault-Tec Corporation]], which draws the attention of all of the attendees. ==Appearances== The meeting attendees appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|6=106|7=107}} ==Behind the scenes== The meeting attendees are portrayed by uncredited background performers. One attendee is played by [[Mitchell Beck]], the hair department head on the ''Fallout'' film crew, as a cameo role. Other background performers include [[Iván Amaro Bullón]] and [[Grace Katherine Harding]]. {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
